email_convention: self-register on e-commerce apps using your @intigriti.me address
notes: Intigriti public program (Open, Retail). Automated tooling ALLOWED at max 5 requests/sec.
MANDATORY: every request's User-Agent must contain an @intigriti.me identifier (required_ua).
Tier 1 = e-commerce apps (www/app/media/api iciparisxl.{nl,be,lu}) — the main focus & highest bounty.
Tier 5 = wildcards (*.iciparisxl.{nl,be,lu}, *.pourvous.nl) — lower impact, may earn bonuses.
Shared Hybris/SAP codebase: a bug on one asset may apply across assets (treated as one issue).
Focus: e-commerce payment/order flows, API/microservice authz, customer-data processing.
Out-of-scope classes include: rate-limit bypass, self-XSS, missing headers, CSRF low-impact, email spoofing/SPF/DMARC, banner/version disclosure, blind SSRF w/o impact — do NOT report these.
Do NOT brute-force login/OTP/giftcards/promo/registration (explicitly out of scope). Governor rate-cap enforced.
